Whatever involves others is always logged: watching over someone, sharing, healing, comforting, quarrelling… Entries already written are kept.

config.calculAide: One core: humans live each step one after another, as until version 0.22.0. Several cores: they live each step at the same time, spread over the cores; the story is not the same as with one core, but the same seed gives the same world whatever their number. The fastest depends on the machine and the number of humans: compare the speed reached. The change applies from the next step.
config.clemenceAide: The Entity's hand: the share of the risks of disease (epidemics included), infection, death in childbirth, death of children under 5 and death in disasters that it wards off. At 0%, the world as it is; at 100%, nobody dies of these causes any more. Hunger, thirst, cold, old age, wars and murders do not change. Each change is logged in the journal as an act of the Entity; it applies from the next step.
